units.source_text: “町子不愿意认为背叛了我，才不得不想出这些话来吧，

en.t: Machiko must not have wanted to think that she had betrayed me, and so she had no choice but to come up with words like these,

units.source_text: 一想到这点，我反而觉得町子你太可怜。”

en.t: and when I think of that, Machiko, I feel all the more that you are terribly pitiable.
